headline: Wardens Restore Callahan Front While Fierce Carnage Grips Weathered Expanse
war_summary: Since our last dispatch, the central and northern fronts have witnessed swift shifts in fortune amidst staggering attrition. In Callahan's Passage, Warden forces completely erased the earlier Colonial foothold, re-establishing control over all ten strategic bases while both armies absorbed more than 3,300 casualties in two hours of accelerating combat. The butchery reached even greater heights across Weathered Expanse, where over 3,700 men fell in two hours and another contested bastion collapsed into ruined no-man's-land, leaving four Colonial redoubts, one Warden base, and four neutral ruins. Along the Nevish Line, sustained Warden assaults reduced the Colonial presence to a solitary stronghold, securing seven of eight positions across six rapid exchanges. Fresh engagements also broke out in adjoining sectors: Warden units captured Mox in Marban Hollow, while Kuoppa in the Gutter weathered multiple rapid reversals before settling back into Warden hands. Base turnover paused in Mooring County despite sharply rising casualty rates, while Colonials consolidated their hold on Briar in Stlican Shelf. Meanwhile, Dead Lands and Linn of Mercy remain largely locked in subdued attrition.
